lead.headline: Tuten is still limited — and your lineup still has no net under him
lead.deck: Move him to FLEX and Gordon to RB. Waddle's full practice gives you a second fallback.
lead.body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten was limited Wednesday with his ankle and foot and is still questionable, and the lineup has not changed since Wednesday afternoon — Diggs in FLEX, Gordon on the bench, every back you own locking at 12:00. If Jacksonville declare Tuten inactive at 13:55, nobody can replace him. Put Gordon in an RB slot and Tuten in FLEX: it is the projection lineup, and it makes Waddle (15:25) and Diggs (Monday) live fallbacks. Waddle practised in full Wednesday for the first time since his concussion. Jefferson's quarterback is Kirk Cousins again — Kyler Murray did not practise — and Jordan Addison is out after thumb surgery, which keeps the targets his. Geno Smith, Wilson's quarterback, was limited. Fairbairn kicks tonight with Houston 12.5-point favourites.
